data.desc: Haoxin Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides temperature-controlled truckload transportation and urban delivery services in the People's Republic of China. The Company primarily provides transportation services using large and medium-sized temperature-controlled logistics vehicles and also offers urban delivery services using medium-sized vans to customers with short-distance, intra-city delivery needs. The goods transported by the Company mainly include electronic devices, chemicals, fruit, food and commercial goods. Haoxin Holdings Limited's transportation network covers 30 of the 34 provinces and autonomous regions in China.
